text: Binance Bridge what is Binance Bridge? Binance Bridge is a bridge service that provides access to inter blockchain liquidity for Binance Chain, Binance Smart Chain, and Ethereum decentralized applications and brings valuable assets such as busd, usdt, and ETH to the Binance Chain ecosystem. How does Binance Bridge Work? The Binance Bridge service allows users to transfer crypto assets in and out of different blockchains. Let's use Bob as an example to go over how it works. Bob wants to transfer BTC from Ethereum to Binance Smart Chain. First, Bob needs to submit a request to make the exchange from Ethereum to Binance Smart Chain via Binance Bridge. The Binance Bridge service provider will then allocate an Ethereum address that corresponds to the deposit. Next, Bob needs to deposit BTC from his Ethereum address to the Ethereum address provided by Binance Bridge within the specified time period. After Bob completes the transfer, the Binance Bridge service provider will prompt the transfer progress and send the equivalent amount of mapped tokens to the recipient's account. Bob can also see the balance of the mapped tokens. Once the transaction is complete, the Binance Bridge server will lock all the tokens and finalize the exchange of tokens from Ethereum to the Binance Smart Chain. Bob will be charged a fixed network fee according to the selected network, and the fee amount depends on the blockchain. If Bob fails to deposit the agreed amount of tokens to the address or fails to deposit them within the specified time frame, the tokens will be returned to the original ETH address. How to Get Started with Binance Bridge before using Binance Bridge services, you will need a decentralized wallet. Wallets such as Binance Chain Wallet and Metamask are all supported. Let's take a look at how to get set up with the Binance Chain Wallet. Visit the Binance chain official website binance.org and select Binance Chain Wallet Extension under the Wallet menu. Once the extension is installed, the plugin icon will appear at the right top of your browser. Click on the icon to create your wallet and password. Your password must contain at least eight characters, an uppercase letter, a digit number, and a symbol. Once your password is created, you will receive a 12 word recovery phrase to back up your wallet. Please keep your 12 word recovery phrase in a safe place. Now you're all set to start using your Binance Chain wallet. Steps on how to Use Binance Bridge let's go step by step on how to use Binance Bridge. Log in to the Binance chain official website binance.org click bridge button first you need to connect your wallet. Click Connect Wallet. After connecting, your wallet address will be displayed at the top right of the web page. Please make sure that you choose the correct network that is Binance Chain or Binance Smart Chain. After switching the Binance Smart Chain network, you will be able to use the Binance Bridge service. Now let's make a BTC transfer from Ethereum to Binance Smart Chain. Show as an example, select BTC as the asset and Ethereum as the network. Then enter the amount of BTC that you would like to transfer. Please note that there is a minimum amount limit and maximum amount limit to use the service. Click next to receive the deposit address provided by Binance Bridge. In addition, the network fee will also be listed. You only need to deposit the corresponding amount of your selected asset to the provided address. Please note that you need to complete your deposit within the designated time frame listed on the page. If you need to transfer a large amount of your selected asset, it is recommended that you try to transfer a small amount first to ensure that your address and other settings are correct. Generally, the transfer time frame depends on the confirmation of the block network node and it may take some time to process. Please wait patiently. The Binance Bridge service was created to help users transfer crypto assets such as btc, usdt, and BUSD to different chains efficiently and effectively. Binance Bridge will support more cryptocurrencies in the future. Binance Bridge A bridge service to bring your assets across blockchains.
